notes: DeepFlux 6.0 - local uncensored AI: the agent can now run entirely on your machine through a bundled llama.cpp engine - the installer offers to download a model matched to your GPU/RAM, no cloud key needed. Cloud providers are unchanged and still built in. The installer is 380 MB smaller: FlareSolverr is now downloaded during setup instead of bundled (digest-pinned, official release).
